company.name: IREDA
company.ownership: This profile covers Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited, a company owned by the Government of India and registered with the Reserve Bank of India as a non-banking financial company. It lends money to clean-energy projects; it does not build or run the power plants itself.
products: Lending for solar farms and rooftop solar
Lending for river and dam power stations
Lending for fuel and power made from farm and food waste
Lending for power made from rubbish
Lending for hydrogen fuel made with clean electricity
Lending for lines that carry electricity
Lending for clean-fuel and solar-equipment makers
company.productNote: Financing sectors reviewed on IREDA’s website on 31 October 2026. Each picture is a real photograph from Wikimedia Commons of the kind of project IREDA lends to, with the photographer credited. None is a photograph of a project IREDA has financed.
